lines.t: Three years, that's a thousand days
And not yet, the sun goes down
But the pain is a permanent set
I had to take the photos down
I couldn't look at the frames
Every smile in the glass
Was like fuel in the flames
But now the silence is violent
It's stealing the sound
I'm digging for your laughter
And the frozen up ground, the breakfast table's a desert, a monument of wood
I'd trade a decade just to hear you laugh, I would
But the signal is fading, the memory's getting thin
I'm losing the battle to the hollow within, Lord
I'm a puzzle with a piece torn out, just a shell in a desert of doubt
And my heart, it's a bruise, it's a deep shade of blue
Cause I know exactly what the world is gonna do to you
You're gonna come back home and the light's gonna be dimmed
Edges all jagged and your spirit untrimmed
You won't be the girl with the sun in her eyes
You'll be suffocating under a thousand dark lies
It kills me to know you'll have scars just like mine
New wounds on a soul that was meant to be divine
I cannot go back, I cannot return
I walked through the fire and I felt the burn
I am anchored in love, I am settled in life
I'm holding the Father through the dead of the night
He is my life, He is my all
I'm staying right here behind this wall
I'm mourning the version of you that walked out that door
But I'm claiming the version the Lord's gonna restore
Standing in the hallway, feeling the death
Now I'm standing in the hallway till there's nothing else left
I know the mender, the one who heals deep
The keeper of promises he's gonna keep
He mended my spirit, he'll have to mend yours
I'm screaming for mercy behind these doors
I cannot go back
I cannot return
I walked through the fire
And I felt the burn, burn
I cannot go back
I cannot return
I walked through the fire
And I felt the burn, burn, burn, burn
You heal the scars
Just like he did mine
The same mercy
The same peace
I can't hear your laugh
But I'm staying
I'm staying
I'm staying
